name: Taifoon — Jev on-chain grader (grade → stamp → devnet)

nodes.name: When clicking ‘Execute workflow’
nodes.notes: in: — → out: — · start a grading run

nodes.name: Ready jobs (Base)
nodes.notes: in: — → out: job.json · GET /v1/judge/ready: jobs on Base that were paid and delivered, and nobody ruled

nodes.name: Pick 4 calibrated
nodes.notes: in: job.json → out: job.json · keep four whose seller has a calibrated record; one item per job, no state built here

nodes.name: Judge · prepare
nodes.notes: in: job.json → out: facts.json · POST /v1/judge/compose (prepare) on the job: facts decide first; the pack comes from the job evidence (GRADEABLE labels 1–21)

nodes.name: Hard fail?
nodes.notes: in: facts.json → out: facts.json · a hard fail is final at prepare (Jev is not asked; nothing to stamp)

nodes.name: Jev · TypeSafe (our credential)
nodes.notes: in: facts.json → out: answers.json · TypeSafe ask on the prepared text (jevStateOf): every RUBRIC_ASKED answer with its whole distribution

nodes.name: Judge · answers
nodes.notes: in: answers.json → out: verdict.json · POST /v1/judge/compose (answers): recompose under THRESHOLDS_v1, record decision.v2 and the answers, anchor both

nodes.name: Verdict
nodes.notes: in: verdict.json → out: verdict.json · the recorded decision as a canonical VERDICT (fromDecision), composed from this run’s receipt

nodes.name: Stamp Grade (unsigned)
nodes.notes: in: verdict.json → out: verdict.json · POST /v1/assurance/call stampGrade: the unsigned GradeStampRegistry.stamp(subject_id, digest, verdict code, mode 2)

nodes.name: Taifoon Devnet Signer
nodes.notes: in: verdict.json → out: verdict.json · sign and send the stamp on devnet 36927 (anvil #0)

nodes.name: Verdict + stamp
nodes.notes: in: verdict.json → out: verdict.json · the same VERDICT with the stamp transaction appended to anchors
